item.title: Mamdani to revive Bronx bus lane killed by ex-Mayor Eric Adams
item.description: Bus ridership in the Bronx plummeted while former Mayor Eric Adams was in office. Ex-Mayor Eric Adams notoriously killed a plan to bring more bus priority to busy Fordham Road after facing pushback from local businesses and institutions. [ more › ]

item.title: NYC’s alternate side parking dance is on hiatus, leaving crusty cars all over town
item.description: A car registered to the U.S. military was surrounded by snow and ice weeks after a storm blanketed thi city.
